principles: Lattice CLI is the primary product surface; Mac App is optional/dashboard only.
Host-neutral means third-party hosts do intelligence; Lattice does lifecycle, evidence, handoff, authority, and thin conduit only.
Production authority requires verified server receipts, never local cache or transport accepted flags.
0.3.5 must preserve Koala compatibility while making Lattice the public name.
Every migration surface must be testable through CLI JSON or focused smoke tests.
drivers: User wants to stop depending on Mac App and use Codex, Claude Code, Gemini directly.
Existing projects and Koala story tooling still depend on koala command names.
Authority overclaim risk is high because local CLI/conduit/cache can be confused with server receipts.

options.name: A: Hard rename everything to lattice immediately
cons: Breaks existing koala story tooling and downstream scripts
High migration blast radius for a single release

options.name: B: Lattice CLI primary with koala legacy alias
pros: Makes Lattice the user-facing product while preserving current workflows
Allows focused 0.3.5 delivery with explicit deprecation path
Keeps story tooling usable during transition
cons: Docs and tests must guard against mixed authority language

options.name: C: Keep Koala name and only document Lattice as architecture
cons: Does not satisfy user decision to rename product

chosen: B: Lattice CLI primary with koala legacy alias
rationale: This option delivers the requested Lattice CLI 0.3.5 product direction while preserving existing Koala command compatibility and avoiding a risky hard rename in one release.

preMortem.scenario: Legacy Koala workflows break after adding lattice branding
preMortem.trigger: Existing scripts expect koala bin, KOALA_* env vars, or @koala-agent/core package name
preMortem.consequence: Developers cannot run story gates or validate current worktrees
preMortem.mitigation: Keep koala bin/entrypoint as legacy alias, dual-read old env vars, and add smoke tests for koala compatibility.

preMortem.scenario: Lattice Conduit is misunderstood as a new coding agent
preMortem.trigger: Docs or help describe conduit as runner/worker without clear host-neutral boundary
preMortem.consequence: Product appears to compete with Codex/Claude/Gemini and violates user intent
preMortem.mitigation: Document and test wording that conduit is thin job/event/evidence transport only and does not provide model reasoning or production authority.

preMortem.scenario: Local CLI accepted response is mistaken for receipt-backed authority
preMortem.trigger: authority or evidence command displays accepted/record refs without receipt verification caveat
preMortem.consequence: productionDone may be overclaimed from local or transport state
preMortem.mitigation: Keep authority text and JSON explicit: receiptVerified false unless verified; productionDone requires server receipt; add overclaim smoke coverage.
